912.text: "I am a generous king, aren't I? Romus the Generous, they call me."

913.speaker: Player_Romus
913.text: "I would not dare to double-cross you, Mr. Smolak. I know what Wehlen is capable of."

914.speaker: Player_Romus
914.text: "I offered what I felt was right. I had no idea you would've also been happy with less."

915.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
915.text: "I never said I would have been happy with less, Your Majesty. But I suppose we will never know."

916.speaker: Narrator
916.text: He grinned broadly. Laurento quickly paged through the treaty document again.

917.speaker: Player_Romus
917.text: "Call it a symbol of my greater intentions. I too wish for our countries to resume our former partnership."

918.speaker: Narrator
918.text: As he reached the end, his face assumed a pleasant expression.

920.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
920.text: "I see the beginnings of a fair deal."

924.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
924.text: "You are attempting to stick poor Wehlen with an unfair trade deal."

925.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
925.text: "You are refusing to improve the status of my people in your country."
925.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_TradeDifferential"] < 0) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_WehlenTreaty_PromiseWorkingRights"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_WehlenTreaty_PromiseFullRights"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_WehlenTreaty_PromiseGoldExport"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Budget"] > 0) == false)

932.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
932.text: "I am rather concerned about the trade imbalance."

933.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
933.text: "It irks me that you are refusing to send us gold, the commodity we need the most."

937.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
937.text: "You are not even agreeing to send us gold, the commodity we need the most."

941.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
941.text: "You are content to watch us suffer alone in our fight against the Bludish Freedom Front."
941.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_TradeDifferential"] < 0) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_WehlenTreaty_PromiseWorkingRights"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_WehlenTreaty_PromiseFullRights"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_WehlenTreaty_PromiseGoldExport"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Budget"] > 0) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_WehlenTreaty_PromiseBFFAid"] == false)

942.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
942.text: "I do wish you had agreed to grant full rights to Wehzeks in your country."
942.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_TradeDifferential"] < 0) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_WehlenTreaty_PromiseGoldExport"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Budget"] > 0) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_WehlenTreaty_PromiseFullRights"] == false)

946.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
946.text: "Of course, more aid against the Bludish insurgent problem would have been helpful."
946.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_TradeDifferential"] < 0) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_WehlenTreaty_PromiseGoldExport"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Budget"] > 0) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_WehlenTreaty_PromiseFullRights"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_WehlenTreaty_PromiseDerdianBan"] == false  or Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_WehlenTreaty_PromiseBFFAid"] == false)

954.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
954.text: "Do you fancy yourself a witty individual? An amusing fellow?"

955.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
955.text: "Neither will making a mockery of my fine proposal."

956.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
956.text: "To me, your unwillingness to cooperate shows that you cannot be trusted to resume governance of Zille."
956.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_TradeDifferential"] < 0) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_WehlenTreaty_PromiseWorkingRights"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_WehlenTreaty_PromiseFullRights"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_WehlenTreaty_PromiseGoldExport"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Budget"] > 0) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_WehlenTreaty_PromiseBFFAid"] == false) == false)

957.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
957.text: "But if the rest of the conditions are still met in three years' time, I see no reason not to proceed with the Zille handover."
957.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_TradeDifferential"] < 0) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_WehlenTreaty_PromiseGoldExport"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Budget"] > 0) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_WehlenTreaty_PromiseFullRights"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_WehlenTreaty_PromiseDerdianBan"] == false  or Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_WehlenTreaty_PromiseBFFAid"] == false) == false)

958.speaker: Player_Romus
958.text: "I would not dare to double-cross you, Mr. Smolak. I know what Wehlen is capable of."

959.speaker: Player_Romus
959.text: "I wish I could have offered more. But if you're satisfied, then so am I."

960.speaker: Player_Romus
960.text: "This is a historic moment, Mr. President. I am looking forward to closer cooperation between our two nations."

961.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
961.text: "We will resume it, Your Majesty. Together, we will be stronger than ever before."

962.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
962.text: "And it was not my intention for both of us to walk out of this room empty-handed."

963.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
963.text: "But by completely dismissing my concerns, you've proven to me that you cannot be trusted to resume governance of Zille."

964.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
964.text: "This was not a joke, Your Majesty. I came here as a gesture of good faith."

965.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
965.text: "I did not come here to ask for atonement. I came to ask for cooperation."

966.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
966.text: "I did not expect you to agree to everything, Your Majesty. Only to take me seriously."

967.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
967.text: "Please don't be too hasty about this, Mr. President. Just because His Majesty does not agree with your terms does not mean we cannot find common ground."

968.speaker: Player_Romus
968.text: "Again, I apologize. But I cannot offer any more than what I already have."

974.speaker: Player_Romus
974.text: "Wait. I am not entirely inflexible. Surely there's still a way to find common ground."

975.speaker: Player_Romus
975.text: "This was rigged from the start. There was nothing that would have satisfied you, was there?"

976.speaker: Narrator
976.text: Smolak sighed theatrically and raised his hands.

980.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
980.text: "Alas, this meeting has been a waste of both my time and yours."

981.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
981.text: "Thank you for the pastries. But Wehlen's are really much better."

983.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
983.text: "There is one further condition which my ministers advised me not to include in the agreement."

984.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
984.text: "If you do this for me in addition to meeting the conditions you already agreed on, I can envision allowing the Zille handover to proceed."

985.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
985.text: "There is one further condition which my ministers advised me not to include in the agreement."

986.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
986.text: "If you agree to aid us in our operations against the Bludish Freedom Front and grant me this one additional favor, I can envision allowing the handover of Zille to proceed."

987.speaker: Player_Romus
987.text: "I will not negotiate any further, Mr. President. This meeting is over."

988.speaker: Player_Romus
988.text: "What is this favor and why did your ministers advise you not to include it?"

989.speaker: Player_Romus
989.text: "I can already tell you that providing assistance against the Bludish Freedom Front is a hard no. I don't need to hear the other favor."

991.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
991.text: "You see, like the Bludish Freedom Front, your Su Omina organization has many different heads."

992.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
992.text: "But there is one that stands above all others. Ricardus Toras."

993.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
993.text: "Your inflexibility is a pity, Your Majesty. If we world leaders are not willing to bend, we will break."

994.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
994.text: "Deal with him, and we can restart this conversation."

995.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
995.text: "A pleasure to meet you, Mr. Esquibel. I know how much you wanted this agreement to go through."

997.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
997.text: "I want what is best for this kingdom, Mr. President. And ultimately, that is up to my king to decide."

998.speaker: Player_Romus
998.text: "Precisely. You cannot get around this by appealing to my council, Mr. Smolak."

999.speaker: Player_Romus
999.text: "I took Mr. Esquibel's opinion into account, of course. But in the end, I would rather make no deal than an unfair one."

1000.speaker: Player_Romus
1000.text: "Thank you, Mr. Esquibel. It is a hard burden to bear, but bear it I must."

1004.speaker: Player_Romus
1004.text: "And my decisions are in turn guided by the hand of God. By His will, this agreement was not meant to be."

1005.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1005.text: "Dastnurist or Wruhecist, we all worship the same God. But he must be telling the two of us different things."

1006.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1006.text: "I understand. Just as I must take sole responsibility for ensuring Zille's security."

1007.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1007.text: "That is your right. As it is my right to take Zille's safety into my own hands."

1008.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1008.text: "I understand. I too prefer a... hands-on leadership style."

1009.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1009.text: "I must head back to Wraclawitz and tell my ministers the news. Good day, gentlemen."

1010.speaker: Player_Romus
1010.text: "This is not over. You'll be hearing from us."

1014.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1014.text: "Thank you for your time, Mr. President. We'll have an aide show you out."

1015.speaker: Narrator
1015.text: We accompanied Smolak to the door of the suite. He bowed one last time as an aide ushered him down the hall towards the exit.

1016.speaker: Narrator
1016.text: Laurento and I looked at each other for a long couple of moments.

1018.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1018.text: "A contingency plan it is, then, Your Majesty."

1019.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1019.text: "But we will have to save that discussion for another day."

1020.speaker: Narrator
1020.text: We packed up and left the suite.

1022.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1022.text: "I had a feeling that might be the case. But I had to try."

1023.speaker: Player_Romus
1023.text: "We shouldn't try to negotiate any further. This was rigged from the start."

1024.speaker: Player_Romus
1024.text: "Are you absolutely sure, Mr. Smolak? There must be something further we can offer you."

1025.speaker: Player_Romus
1025.text: "I would advise you to reconsider, Mr. Smolak. I'll remind you that we are committed to getting Zille back by *any* means necessary."

1026.speaker: Player_Romus
1026.text: "I would advise you to reconsider, Mr. Smolak. I'll remind you that we are committed to getting Zille back by *any* means necessary."

1027.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1027.text: "For once we agree. There is no use in continuing as long as your attitude towards us stays the same."

1028.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1028.text: "Unfortunately, it is too late. This was our final offer, and you rejected it."

1029.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1029.text: "Immediately resorting to threats. See, this proves our meeting was doomed to fail."

1033.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1033.text: "Even if the Zille bombing suspects were acting independently, they were still inspired by his words."

1034.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1034.text: "We suspect he is involved in the Zille incident."

1035.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1035.text: "Meanwhile, he has shown nothing but contempt for the Wehzeks living under his jurisdiction."

1036.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1036.text: "A recent wave of crimes against Wehzek citizens in Zille may be linked to him and his organization as well."

1040.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1040.text: "A country that allows a man like that to remain in power is not a country where my people will be safe."

1041.speaker: Player_Romus
1041.text: "I do not share my cousin's views. Neither does the majority of Rizia."

1042.speaker: Player_Romus
1042.text: "I can't just get rid of him. Give me a chance and I will rein him in."

1043.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1043.text: "I'm afraid I don't understand. Duke Toras has committed no crime."

1044.speaker: Player_Romus
1044.text: "You have my attention. Please go on."

1045.speaker: Narrator
1045.text: A shadow flickered across his face.

1046.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1046.text: "The same could be said for Rizia. But I am confident that both of our countries will hold up their respective ends of this bargain."

1047.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1047.text: "No need for regrets, Your Majesty. We did not expect you to agree to everything."

1048.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1048.text: "Yes, we are forging history, you and I. Our predecessors would be proud."

1049.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1049.text: "Needless to say, you are welcome in Wraclawitz anytime to further discuss the particularities of the agreement."

1050.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1050.text: "We merely expected your cooperation. Which is exactly what we received."

1051.speaker: Player_Romus
1051.text: "Are you sure that timeline can't be adjusted?"

1052.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1052.text: "My hands are tied. My government wants to know these changes will last."

1053.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1053.text: "That's very kind of you, President Smolak. We will be sure to keep in contact."

1054.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1054.text: "I'm very happy we could reach an agreement, President Smolak. I know both of our countries are aiming for a secure handover."

1055.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1055.text: "Rest assured we will, President Smolak. We will be sure to keep you updated on our progress."

1056.speaker: Narrator
1056.text: He nodded, then broke into a grin.

1057.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1057.text: "I wish I had time to celebrate, but Wraclawitz awaits."

1061.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1061.text: "On my next visit to Porte Drazon, we will smoke khisha together!"

1062.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1062.text: "The next time you visit us, we will smoke khisha together. You'll discover what you're missing out on!"

1063.speaker: Player_Romus
1063.text: "That sounds like a plan, Mr. President."

1064.speaker: Player_Romus
1064.text: "I'll leave the smoking to my mother. But I do look forward to our next meeting."

1065.speaker: Player_Romus
1065.text: "Thank you, but I'd rather that our relationship remain professional."

1066.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1066.text: "That's what khisha is for! A shared celebration between professionals."

1068.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1068.text: "Yes. Tell the Queen Mother to join us next time as well."

1070.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1070.text: "An aide will show you out while we finish up in here, Mr. Smolak. Thanks again for your time."

1071.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1071.text: "Thank *you*, Mr. Esquibel. And you, of course, King Romus."

1074.speaker: Player_Romus
1074.text: "Have a safe trip back, Mr. President."

1075.speaker: Narrator
1075.text: We accompanied Smolak to the door of the suite. He bowed one last time as an aide ushered him down the hall towards the exit.

1076.speaker: Narrator
1076.text: Laurento and I looked at each other for a long couple of moments.

1078.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1078.text: "We have quite the task before us, don't we? But I'm confident we'll rise to the challenge."

1079.speaker: Narrator
1079.text: Laurento gathered up the documents that were scattered across the table. Together, we left the suite.

1081.speaker: Narrator
1081.text: A shadow flickered across his face.

1082.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1082.text: "The same could be said for Rizia. But I am confident that both of our countries will hold up their respective ends of this bargain."

1083.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1083.text: "Rest assured we will, President Smolak. We will be sure to keep you updated on our progress."

1084.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1084.text: "And rightly so! A shame that presidents don't get such epithets."

1088.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1088.text: "I like you, Your Majesty. You're one jocular chap."

1089.speaker: Player_Romus
1089.text: "One of the perks of being a monarch. You should try it sometime."

1090.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1090.text: "I hope you will remember the Kingdom of Rizia's generosity, President Smolak. We may need your support one day."

1091.speaker: Narrator
1091.text: Laurento quickly paged through the treaty document again.

1092.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1092.text: "Considering our countries' respective situations, we have indeed promised you quite a lot. I hope you will remember our kingdom's generosity in future dealings."

1093.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1093.text: "We will provide it. Just as we have in the past. But first I need to see actions, not just words."

1094.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1094.text: "I will, Mr. Esquibel. But first I need to see actions, not just words."

1096.speaker: Narrator
1096.text: Smolak fixed us both with a hawk-like stare.

1097.speaker: Player_Romus
1097.text: "It's rich to hear this kind of talk from you, Mr. President. Remind me again about your plans for the Bluds?"

1098.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1098.text: "I am fighting the spread of terrorism. Your cousin, meanwhile, is terrorizing innocents based on the country of their birth."

1099.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1099.text: "You've had every chance to do so since taking the throne."

1100.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1100.text: "Instead, you have assisted him in his goals by sending him personnel."

1107.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1107.text: "Instead, you have defended his vile organization."

1108.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1108.text: "And you have assisted him in his goals by sending him personnel."

1115.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1115.text: "And you have defended his vile organization."

1116.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1116.text: "You have had every chance to stop him, Your Majesty."

1117.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1117.text: "It is not enough simply to not support him. He must be stripped of his power."

1118.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1118.text: "It is not enough simply to not support him. He must be stripped of his power."

1119.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1119.text: "It is my wish that he be arrested and extradited to Wehlen, where he will learn the true meaning of justice."

1120.speaker: Player_Romus
1120.text: "What do you mean by 'deal with him?'"

1121.speaker: Player_Romus
1121.text: "Rico is my blood kin. I will not throw him to the wolves."

1122.speaker: Player_Romus
1122.text: "Rico is a noble from the most powerful family in Rizia. He cannot be treated like a common criminal."

1123.speaker: Player_Romus
1123.text: "I'd like to get him out of the way as well. But we need to be strategic about it."

1124.speaker: Player_Romus
1124.text: "Arresting him would provoke the rage of the rest of his organization. Your people would be worse off than before."

1126.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1126.text: "Mr. Smolak, I understand your concerns about Duke Toras. But to turn him over to your country would require a trial and a conviction, followed by lengthy legal proceedings."

1127.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1127.text: "Then the rest of the organization should be neutralized as well, shouldn't it?"

1128.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1128.text: "That is the country you wish to rule, Your Majesty? A place where nobles are not beholden to the same laws as everyone else?"

1129.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1129.text: "Your family ties are so strong that you'll allow thousands to suffer as a result of that one man?"

1130.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1130.text: "That would be your problem to solve, Mr. Esquibel. Not mine."

1131.speaker: Player_Romus
1131.text: "Are you sure there's nothing else Rizia can offer you? The thought of turning over my cousin makes me uneasy."

1132.speaker: Player_Romus
1132.text: "We have already been investigating his organization. There's a good chance something will turn up."

1136.speaker: Player_Romus
1136.text: "We'd need to investigate him first. That alone could take ages."

1137.speaker: Player_Romus
1137.text: "I can call for the arrest of whomever I want, on whatever grounds."

1138.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1138.text: "He is the son of your Grand Vizier, Your Majesty. You cannot arrest him without consequences."

1139.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1139.text: "Even if evidence against Duke Toras were revealed, we would need to proceed with extreme caution. Your Grand Vizier will try to block this with all his might."

1141.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1141.text: "You have rejected everything else. This is my sole request."

1142.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1142.text: "I must be leaving soon, King Romus. Will you cooperate with this request or not?"

1146.speaker: Player_Romus
1146.text: "You leave me with no choice. I will support your anti-BFF campaign and remove my cousin from power."

1147.speaker: Player_Romus
1147.text: "For the sake of our countries' old friendship, I will. And I will help you against the Bludish Freedom front."

1148.speaker: Player_Romus
1148.text: "I'm sorry, Mr. President, but I can't help you. We will have to end negotiations here."

1149.speaker: Player_Romus
1149.text: "I would never turn in my own cousin. And it offends me that you have asked."

1150.speaker: Player_Romus
1150.text: "I'll find a way to get you Rico. Just as I will meet your other conditions."

1151.speaker: Player_Romus
1151.text: "I'll add Rico to my list of promises. But there had better be no demands after this one."

1152.speaker: Narrator
1152.text: Smolak stared at me imperiously for a few seconds, then broke into a wide smile.

1153.speaker: Narrator
1153.text: Smolak stared at me imperiously for a few seconds, then broke into a wide smile.

1154.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1154.text: "Fantastic, Your Majesty! I knew you would come through in the end."

1157.speaker: Narrator
1157.text: Smolak stared at me imperiously for a few seconds, then grinned.

1158.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1158.text: "Understood, Your Majesty. Blood is blood, after all. I will not hold this against you."

1165.speaker: Player_Romus
1165.text: "Our new era of cooperation with Wehlen begins now."

1166.speaker: Player_Romus
1166.text: "The bastard has us right where he wants us. But I see no other choice."

1167.speaker: Player_Romus
1167.text: "Your confidence and your assistance are both most appreciated."

1168.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1168.text: "You are right. This could be the beginning of something much larger."

1169.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1169.text: "Let's hope it doesn't come to that."

1170.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1170.text: "We made out fairly well, considering the circumstances."

1171.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1171.text: "I am only doing my royal duty."

1173.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1173.text: "I will. Wehlen's not very far away, after all."

1175.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1175.text: "I will. Wehlen is not so far away, after all."

1183.speaker: Player_Romus
1183.text: "Is Bludish Golcondism the same as that practiced in Derdia?"

1184.speaker: Player_Romus
1184.text: "I think the correct term is 'Bludish people.'"

1185.speaker: Player_Romus
1185.text: "Well, we are persecuting Golcondists as well. They're barred from our holy sites."

1186.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1186.text: "Yes, but they are still welcome within our borders."

1187.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1187.text: "There are a few divergences. Mostly regarding the use of violence against an opponent who has not directly provoked you."

1188.speaker: Hugo Toras
1188.text: "Excuse me, Your Majesty. I had no idea you were sensitive about such language."

1189.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1189.text: "Your house already claimed Iza. It doesn't seem fair to punish the entire province based on the acts of a handful of individuals."

1191.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1191.text: "The Esquibels, for instance, have been nothing but loyal to your family. What will happen to our estates in Zille?"

1192.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1192.text: "Bludish Golcondist scripture forbids this, though the definition of 'provoked' is often stretched. The Derdians allow it when their Supreme Wiseman has deemed that it is for the greater good."

1193.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1193.text: "Whatever the name... Wehlen's president has been stoking the flames of hate against his Bludish citizens."

1195.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1195.text: "Where Wehlen once similarly tolerated its Golcondist citizens, President Smolak now stokes the flames of hate against them."

1196.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1196.text: "He will ask for our aid. But I believe compassion is called for."

1197.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1197.text: "As a matter of fact, doesn't your GRACE organization claim neutrality in the great war of ideas between Arcasia and United Contana?"

1200.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1200.text: "I do hope you're not letting emotions cloud your judgement, Your Highness."

1201.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1201.text: "For what it's worth, I agree with the Princess. And not only because a number of historic Esquibel estates are located in Zille."

1231.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1231.text: "The only commodity they have been trading freely is oil."

1235.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1235.text: "But your current military action towards Pales reveals your kingdom's willingness to put petty territorial concerns above the welfare of its own people."

1236.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1236.text: "I am also worried about your continued partnership with Rumburg, of course."

1237.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1237.text: "Furthermore, your current military action towards Pales reveals your kingdom's willingness to put petty territorial concerns above the welfare of its own people."

1241.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1241.text: "And your continued partnership with Rumburg, in the face of all its efforts to destabilize us, is also a warning sign to me."

1248.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1248.text: "We will leave your cousin out of the official treaty, of course. It'll just be between us."

1257.speaker: Narrator
1257.text: Hugo gave me a significant look.

1258.speaker: Hugo Toras
1258.text: "I think now is the time to tell them, Your Majesty."

1260.speaker: Hugo Toras
1260.text: "A cell of Su Omina has recently been activated in Zille."

1261.speaker: Narrator
1261.text: Laurento and Vina looked horrified. Neither Elena nor Lucita seemed surprised.

1265.speaker: Narrator
1265.text: Laurento looked horrified. Neither Elena nor Lucita seemed surprised.

1268.speaker: Player_Romus
1268.text: "The Duke of Iza's. But I did condone it."

1269.speaker: Player_Romus
1269.text: "I have no idea. They just popped up overnight."

1271.speaker: Narrator
1271.text: He hurriedly shuffled some documents around. Lucita was staring at me intensely.

1273.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1273.text: "I see... And we're not going to do anything about it?"

1275.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1275.text: "A loyalist militia that can't directly be traced to our government... this could prove very useful, Your Majesty."

1276.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1276.text: "But only if they had more arms and better training. Otherwise, they'd just be a nuisance to both sides."

1277.speaker: Narrator
1277.text: Lucita was staring at me intensely.

1278.speaker: Player_Romus
1278.text: "Good point. I'll see what I can do about that."

1279.speaker: Player_Romus
1279.text: "I think we're in a good enough position to negotiate Zille's return without raising the ante."

1280.speaker: Player_Romus
1280.text: "Violence should only be used as a last resort. Otherwise we risk destroying the territory we're trying to gain."

1281.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1281.text: "Of course, Your Majesty. But if negotiations fail, things could go south quickly. We should be prepared."

1286.speaker: Narrator
1286.text: Hugo gave me a significant look.
1286.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Zille_SuOminaActive"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn03_ZilleIncidentResponse_DenounceSO"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Security_GoldenGuard_InvestigateSO"] == false)

1287.speaker: Hugo Toras
1287.text: "My son told me what he offered you in Zille, Your Majesty. Perhaps now would be the time to take him up on it."

1292.speaker: Hugo Toras
1292.text: "We have the option to activate a cell of Su Omina in Zille."

1293.speaker: Narrator
1293.text: Laurento and Vina looked horrified. Neither Elena nor Lucita seemed surprised.

1297.speaker: Narrator
1297.text: Laurento looked horrified. Neither Elena nor Lucita seemed surprised.

1299.speaker: Player_Romus
1299.text: "To put the Wehzek occupiers in their place."

1300.speaker: Player_Romus
1300.text: "I think it's a preposterous idea, too."

1301.speaker: Player_Romus
1301.text: "To no end. Don't listen to my uncle."

1302.speaker: Player_Romus
1302.text: "As a last resort. In case negotiations don't work out."

1303.speaker: Narrator
1303.text: Lucita was staring at me intensely.

1304.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1304.text: "A loyalist militia that can't directly be traced to our government... this could prove very useful, Your Majesty."

1305.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1305.text: "But only if they had more arms and better training. Otherwise, they'd just be a nuisance to both sides."

1306.speaker: Player_Romus
1306.text: "I said no to Rico for a reason. We won't be revisiting this topic."

1308.speaker: Elena Werner
1308.text: "We have the budget to provide both. But sending supplies in secret might prove difficult logistically."

1309.speaker: Elena Werner
1309.text: "Even if we had the budget for this, sending supplies in secret might prove difficult logistically."

1310.speaker: Hugo Toras
1310.text: "Where there is a will, there is a way."

1322.speaker: Narrator
1322.text: Uncle Hugo gave me a questioning look.

1323.speaker: Player_Romus
1323.text: "I don't have time for games. What am I going to do with a chess piece?"

1326.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1326.text: "They are a threat to the region, Your Majesty."

1330.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1330.text: "Not that. In fact, I've been thinking."

1332.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1332.text: "My advances towards you in Qalus were rather ill-advised. I'm afraid I overstepped the bounds of propriety."

1333.speaker: Player_Romus
1333.text: "Quite a few bounds were overstepped that night. Including some I didn't even know existed."

1334.speaker: Player_Romus
1334.text: "What do you mean? We're both unmarried adult nobles. It would be perfectly acceptable for us to be together."

1335.speaker: Player_Romus
1335.text: "Much as I'd love to walk out of these chambers arm in arm with you, I'm afraid you're right."

1339.speaker: Player_Romus
1339.text: "You didn't overstep any bounds. I found your candor refreshing, and I still do."

1341.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1341.text: "If I weren't your councilor, you'd be right."

1342.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1342.text: "But people talk -- on the council and beyond. I'd hate for anyone to think your national security decisions were influenced by our personal intimacy."

1343.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1343.text: "People talk -- on the council and beyond. I'd hate for anyone to think your national security decisions were influenced by our personal intimacy."

1345.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1345.text: "A king and a key member of the Royal Council... it just isn't done."

1347.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1347.text: "Perhaps it's best to keep this under wraps until my father is well enough to resume his position."

1348.speaker: Player_Romus
1348.text: "A secret affair. I confess I'm no stranger to those."

1350.speaker: Player_Romus
1350.text: "Why don't I just kick you off the council now? Titus would love the job, I reckon."

1351.speaker: Narrator
1351.text: Her mouth hung open in astonishment. She laughed.

1352.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1352.text: "He's still ailing, but improving by the day."

1354.speaker: Player_Romus
1354.text: "A pragmatic, beautiful noblewoman. I should have married you ages ago."

1355.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1355.text: "Please tell me you're joking, Your Majesty."

1367.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1367.text: "In the meantime... here's something for luck."

1368.speaker: Player_Romus
1368.text: "Duchess Azaro, a quick moment of your time."

1370.speaker: Player_Romus
1370.text: "Tell President Smolak I'll be a few minutes late. I want to keep him waiting."

1372.speaker: Player_Romus
1372.text: "May I ask if there will be any doodling going on during this meeting, Mr. Esquibel?"

1377.speaker: Narrator
1377.text: Laurento nodded. He didn't speak another word as Titus escorted us through winding corridors to the first-floor diplomatic suite.

1378.speaker: Player_Romus
1378.text: "A confidential security matter. I'll discuss it with you later."

1379.speaker: Player_Romus
1379.text: "No time to explain. Let's get to the meeting."

1381.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1381.text: "But His Majesty does speak out against injustice when he sees it."

1382.speaker: Player_Romus
1382.text: "We persecuted Golcondists for a long time as well. Or have you so easily forgotten our anti-blasphemy law?"

1384.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1384.text: "We disallowed Golcondists from our holy sites, but we did not bar them from our borders."

1392.speaker: Player_Romus
1392.text: "Have you not been keeping abreast of my immigration policy, Mr. President? Any Wehzek citizen has the right to become nationalized as a Rizian."

1394.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1394.text: "As a *Rizian*. Do you wish for our own culture, language and traditions to disappear?"

1415.speaker: Narrator
1415.text: Elena, Hugo and Vina left the room. Lucita seemed to be intentionally delaying her exit. Her eyes locked on to mine.

1419.speaker: Elena Werner
1419.text: "Unfortunately, our current budget is too tight for us to consider offering gold as a trade commodity."

1423.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1423.text: "But I have concerns about the consistency of its supply. So I will leave it out of the agreement."

1424.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1424.text: "We do have other commodities that we can offer instead. Would those be of interest?"

1490.speaker: Titus Gordion
1490.text: "And the few fingerprints that were found near the bomb site don't match any of the ones we have on file for Su Omina members."

1494.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1494.text: "His Majesty has recently made significant investments into Rizia's domestic pharmaceutical industry, President Smolak. Unfortunately, an influx of foreign imports would undermine that."

1498.speaker: Player_Romus
1498.text: "I've heard all I need to about Wehzek imports."
1498.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_WehlenImports_Bazaar"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_WehlenImports_Wood"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_WehlenImports_Pharma"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_WehlenImports_Tobacco"] == true

1502.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1502.text: "Of course, you have trees down here too, and from what I've heard, you're making good use of them. So maybe this isn't an interesting offer at all."

1503.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1503.text: "Of course, you have trees down here. But why not enjoy Rizia's beautiful forests while letting Wehlen do the hard work of cutting ours down?"

1504.speaker: Player_Romus
1504.text: "I acknowledge your point, Your Highness, but please don't speak out of turn."

1505.speaker: Player_Romus
1505.text: "My daughter is right, Mr. Esquibel. Why can't Zille decide for itself?"

1506.speaker: Player_Romus
1506.text: "What, and I suppose next you're going to say Rizians should be able to choose their own King? That's a slippery slope, my dear."

1510.speaker: Player_Romus
1510.text: "Before we go that route, we should try to spin this to our advantage. We have a lot to gain from staying on Wehlen's good side."

1511.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1511.text: "If it comes down to that, we will still need sufficient time to prepare. I'll explain later."

1512.speaker: Narrator
1512.text: Vina reddened and closed her mouth. Everyone else politely ignored the interruption.

1515.speaker: Elena Werner
1515.text: "If I may. Regarding Duchess Azaro's comment..."

1516.speaker: Elena Werner
1516.text: "And three years of building a closer alliance with Wehlen may well work out to our benefit, Your Highness and Your Majesty."

1517.speaker: Elena Werner
1517.text: "Any agreement Wehlen proposes is bound to have an economic aspect."

1534.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1534.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_WehlenImports_Bazaar"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_WehlenImports_Wood"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_WehlenImports_Pharma"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_WehlenImports_Tobacco"] == true

1535.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1535.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_WehlenImports_Bazaar"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_WehlenImports_Wood"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_WehlenImports_Pharma"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_WehlenImports_Tobacco"] == true) == false

1548.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1548.text: "I had a plan, but it seems the Rizian Navy is too small to assist us. If that's the case, there's little point in asking you to stop them from crossing the strait."

1550.speaker: Player_Romus
1550.text: "One day, our navy will expand but not today."

1551.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1551.text: "Still, I trust that if this instability spreads beyond our borders, you will act in your best interests."

1552.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1552.text: "A wise leader knows when to pick his battles. I can respect that."

1554.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1554.text: "As I will in act in mine."

1555.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1555.text: "There are always other terms we can look at."

1556.speaker: Player_Romus
1556.text: "Our proud navy stands ready to ensure the security of the strait. We are prepared to guard our waters."

1557.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1557.text: "Now that is the kind of determination I like to see. A strong navy securing the strait benefits both our nations."

1558.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1558.text: "With Rizia standing firm, those insurgents will have nowhere to run. I almost feel bad for them. Almost."
